verdict.rationale: Vanta publishes dedicated product pages for HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and SOC 2, each describing automated evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and cross-mapping controls across pre-built frameworks from one platform (vanta-docs-16,17,38,51,18,50,12,25). This directly supports the operations-lead need to cover multiple compliance regimes without adopting new tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification (e.g., customer case study or reviewer confirming multi-framework use in practice) and detail on how overlapping controls are deduplicated across frameworks beyond marketing copy.
